notes.title: Frontland Alpha/Beta Survay
notes.content:
[b]Steam Community Hub Announcement: Game Alpha/Beta Test Survey[/b]

Hello Frontland Alpha/Beta Testers!

We hope you're enjoying the beta version of our game! Your participation and feedback are crucial in helping us shape the final release. To ensure we create the best possible experience, we invite you to complete our Beta Test Survey.

🔗 [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfyOe-uu2XvurJovuu2AP-OeVNL2vGLYQVlU89Wlrz2iTB2xg/alreadyresponded]Frontland Alpha/Beta Survey [/url]

Why Your Feedback Matters:

[list]
[*] Refine Gameplay Mechanics: Help us understand what works and what doesn't.
[*] Enhance Graphics and Audio: Share your thoughts on the visual and auditory elements.
[*] Improve Story and Characters: Provide insights on the narrative and character development.
[*] Optimize Multiplayer Experience: Let us know about your multiplayer sessions.
[*] Streamline Usability and Interface: Your feedback will guide us in making the game more user-friendly.
[/list]

[b]Survey Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*] General Information: Tell us a bit about yourself.
[*] Game Experience: Share your overall impressions and playtime.
[*] Detailed Feedback: Rate various aspects of the game and suggest improvements.
[*] Every response is invaluable, and we deeply appreciate your time and effort. Your honest and detailed feedback will directly impact the quality of the final game.
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of our community and helping us make Frontland the best it can be!

Happy Gaming!

— The Frontland Development Team
